reply_construction_scope: Logical replies are freshly constructed codec inputs, not daemon-produced replies or proof of hint recording, object store allocation hints, staging, durability, caps, older-OSD behavior or ENOSPC semantics.
The public MOSDOpReply constructor (MOSDOpReply.h 143-155) keeps the request WRITE/RETURNVEC mode bits and replaces only ONDISK/ONNVRAM/ACK with the explicit acktype: ACK|ONDISK for every vector.

success follows the commit path: the SETALLOCHINT handler sets result 0 and stages the hint (PrimaryLogPG.cc 6717-6730), set_reply_versions(at_version, user_at_version) runs (4325) and the on-commit callback adds ACK|ONDISK (4387); the logical versions are 11'20 and 20.

failok-refused is the logical older-OSD shape: an unrecognized opcode takes the do_osd_ops default -EOPNOTSUPP (8197-8202), FAILOK keeps the per-op -95 and resets the running result (8205-8210), and the following WRITEFULL commits through the same ACK|ONDISK on-commit completion (4387) with versions 11'20 and 20.

enospc is a logical refusal shape on the update_log_only path: a failed may_write do_osd_ops sets update_log_only (8991-8998), execute_ctx skips complete_read_ctx (4316), calls set_reply_versions(at_version, user_at_version) (4325) with the unchanged object user version (4247-4248), adds ACK|ONDISK (4366) and calls record_write_error (4370); the logical versions are 11'20 and 19, so the legacy version is 11'19. The pinned SETALLOCHINT handler itself always sets result 0, and a pool-full FULL_TRY refusal (9012-9024) would instead keep per-op result 0 and take complete_read_ctx.
max follows the success commit path with ACK|ONDISK and versions 11'20 and 20, pinning both 2^64-1 sizes and flags 0x7ff in the echoed union.
